تحذلقت (form IIq)
# تَحَذْلَقْتُ (taḥaḏlaqtu) /ta.ħað.laq.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَحَذْلَقَ (taḥaḏlaqa)
# تَحَذْلَقْتَ (taḥaḏlaqta) /ta.ħað.laq.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَحَذْلَقَ (taḥaḏlaqa)
# تَحَذْلَقْتِ (taḥaḏlaqti) /ta.ħað.laq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَحَذْلَقَ (taḥaḏlaqa)
# تَحَذْلَقَتْ (taḥaḏlaqat) /ta.ħað.la.qat/: t
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
